name: Sunray Tiburon 4-Person Traditional Steam Sauna 400SN
description: Description Experience the relaxation and health benefits of the Tiburon 4-Person Indoor Traditional Sauna, crafted from premium aged Canadian hemlock wood. This durable and naturally beautiful cabin features two-tiered bench seating for maximum comfort and flexibility. Powered by a 6.0 kW Harvia heater, it reaches temperatures up to 176°F, allowing you to enjoy both dry and steam sauna sessions by adding water to the lava stones. With its ergonomic seating, tempered glass door, and user-friendly features, the Tiburon sauna offers a luxurious wellness experience right in your home. Features Spacious corner design comfortably accommodates up to 4 people Durable construction using aged Canadian hemlock wood with natural appeal 6.0 kW Harvia electric heater with lava stones for authentic traditional steam Generates relaxing temperatures up to 176°F for deep wellness benefits Two-tiered bench seating lets you recline or sit at different heat levels Ergonomic backrests designed for comfort during longer sauna sessions Tempered glass door for safety, visibility, and a modern look Built-in thermo-hygrometer to monitor humidity and temperature Sand timer ensures safe, timed sauna sessions Cask and spoon set included for adding steam to the heater stones Interior lighting creates a relaxing ambiance Ventilation system for proper airflow and comfort ETL Safety Certified for quality assurance What's Included?
